cipher: AGS Estado leg. 1394 no. 247 (Garcia de Toledo to Philip II, 16 July 1565)
type: homophonic substitution, two-digit figures 12-43, alphabetical order, no nomenclator groups observed

notes.u: 38/39/40 serve both u and v as written
notes.nn: nn written for the tilde (sennales = senales)
notes.missing: no j, k, w; 21 (f) and 41 (x) are rare
